# laravelforge_php_versions (Resource)

Install a new PHP version on the server

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_php_versions" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
  version      = "php5"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID
- `version` (String)

### Optional

- `cli_default` (Boolean)
- `php_version` (Number) The php version ID
- `site_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_php_versions.example my-org/123456/123
```
